messages:
mike_partnerships: Heads-up: LangChain + Nexus Gateway + SoftServe SI want a co-announcement + marketplace listing late May. Need coordinated plan and owners.

sara_pm: 👍 timeline?

mike_partnerships: Proposed: internal preview 2024-05-24, public 2024-05-31. Must cover: marketplace packaging (AWS/GCP), verified runtime notes for Dedicated, a short co-demo, SI runbook, and legal/brand approvals.

ben_eng: Tech ask: we need a LangChain connector test harness + a sample adapter repo. Also CI smoke tests that run against our Dedicated env and hosted fallback. I can own the SDK pieces.

anya_infra: Can we certify the runtime on our Dedicated shapes in time? I'll need perf numbers from the hardware partner (Nvidia) for A100/H100 — also check quantized variant behavior.

liz_marketing: I'll draft messaging and a co-branded one-pager. Need partner logos and final product names by May 17 to hit design. Also plan embargo and a short customer-facing blog + tweet thread.

tom_sales: Sales enablement deck please — include recommended pricing guidance and an SI services bundle example.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled Tue May 14 09:30 PT — invites sent to @mike_partnerships @sara_pm @ben_eng @liz_marketing @anya_infra @tom_sales

ben_eng: Quick CI snippet I'll add to repo for smoke tests: 
```yaml
steps:
  - run: pytest tests/interop --env=marketplace-smoke
  - run: tools/benchmark/run_baseline.sh --model gpt-j --batch 8
```

jess_legal: We need a joint press checklist and logo usage policy. Share co-brand assets ASAP and ping me for a short review (2 business days).

mike_partnerships: Action items (summarized):
- ben_eng: adapter + smoke CI by May 10
- anya_infra: perf matrix with Nvidia contact and Dedicated validation by May 12
- liz_marketing: messaging + assets by May 17
- tom_sales: enablement deck by May 20
- jess_legal: legal approvals by May 22
I'll own the joint announcement draft and the marketplace listing copy.

anya_infra: Confirmed — I'll loop in @nvidia-pm and run perf baselines on A100/H100. Will also collect KV cache and batching numbers for typical LangChain chains.

mike_partnerships: If anyone can't make the May 14 meeting, drop notes here. Also thinking about including a short orchestration demo using FlowOrch to show canary routing (dedicated -> hosted). Thoughts? @sara_pm

sara_pm: FlowOrch demo ✅. We can show a canary routing rule -> Dedicated pool -> fallback to hosted with retry/backoff. Keeps the demo tight and highlights routing/fallthrough.

tom_sales: Add SI runbook checklist: connector install, secrets & KMS pointers, troubleshooting steps, contact matrix. Will draft a one-pager.

mike_partnerships: Great. I'll create a shared folder and drop the checklist + repo link after the meeting. Thanks all — let's keep updates in this thread.
